name: Nevoia
source:
Nevoia is a free-to-play vampire visual novel. One day you get bitten, but nothing changes in your daily life. Until there is a knock at your door.

Whoever that is, you do [b]not[/b] expect any guests.

[From [url=https://argenttriangle.itch.io/nevoia]Itch.io[/url]]
